up: Return the ChEMBL IDs, preferred names, and molecule types of all compounds reported in document CHEMBL5718513. Include the compound key for reference.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.molecule_type, cr.compound_key FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = cr.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5728513';
